title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Twilio
providers.scope_notes: Twilio cloud APIs; PKCV needs Enterprise or Security Edition, OAuth apps are US1-only, and Monitor Events keeps 30 days (13 months with Administration, Security or Enterprise Edition).

controls.name: Token expiration time
controls.what: Sets access token lifetime from 1 minute to 30 days.
controls.setting: OAuth app > Access settings > Token expiration time

controls.name: Rotate secret (grace period 0) / delete OAuth app
controls.what: Invalidates old credentials and issued access tokens.
controls.setting: OAuth app > Credentials > Rotate secret; OAuth apps > Delete

controls_unknown: IP allowlisting for REST API credentials (Auth Token, API keys, OAuth).
Expiry settings for API keys and Auth Tokens.
Whether org SSO enforcement or SCIM deactivation affects any API credential.
Org-wide policy to block Main key or Auth Token use other than PKCV.
Whether Monitor Events records read (GET) API calls or token issuance.
Whether actor_sid identifies the API key SID (SK) or only the account.

authentication.summary: Client ID and secret exchanged at POST https://oauth.twilio.com/v2/token for a scoped bearer access token.

federation.details: App keeps working if the creating user is removed.

lifetime.summary: Token 1 min to 30 days, default 1 h

renewal.summary: Request a new token with client credentials; rotate secret with 0-30 day grace.

administration.summary: Owner, Administrator, Developer or Account API Access Admin roles manage apps; scopes limit APIs. US1 only.
administration.conditions: Works only for the account it was created in.

offboard.details: Client Credentials apps authenticate as themselves, not on behalf of a user.

inventory.details: Each account lists its apps under Settings > Account settings > OAuth applications; there is no cross-account view.

usage.ui: Monitor > Insights > Audit > Audit Events Log

log_sources.name: Monitor Events
log_sources.notes: OAuth app event types not listed in docs.

containment.steps: Rotate secret with grace period 0, or delete the app.
containment.notes: Invalidates previous credentials and access tokens.

unknown: Event names for OAuth app create/rotate/delete
